Claim 13 (currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising computer-executable software, transmitted as an information signal, for causing a computer to implement the steps of said method, wherein the computer-executable software is stored on a computer-readable medium.

Claim 23 (currently amended): A computer-based system for trading combinations of financial instruments, said system comprising: a processing unit to obtain combination orders to trade financial instruments; and a data storage to obtain a matched collection of expanded eligible orders, wherein an obtained order is eligible if it satisfies at least one selected condition, and wherein said at least one selected condition includes the necessary condition that all financial instruments specified by the legs of an eligible order are in a set of two or more selected financial instruments.

Claim 24 (currently amended): The system of claim 23, further comprising a feedback mechanism for increasing, at least in principle, the quality of said matched collection.

Claim 25 (currently amended): The system of claim 23, further comprising functionality for providing additional trading capabilities.
